label: Feed Entry
description: An entry from an Atom or RSS 2.0 feed, as the RSS connector reads it. Its fields are named as `core.bookmark` names them, so an entry reads as a bookmark and a promoted copy is a bookmark.

title.description: The entry's title, as plain text.

description.description: The entry's summary, as plain text.

body.description: The entry's full content, where the feed carries it, markup and all.

published_at.description: When the feed says the entry was published.

source_url.description: The site the feed belongs to.

entry_id.description: The entry's id in its feed: its Atom id or RSS guid, else its link.

feed_url.description: The feed's address, as the connector was given it, without credentials.
